offer.text: I've taken hurt tending others and my own hands shake too much to mend it. Press a golden carrot on me and let the warmth do its work.

accept.text: Bless you. A healer needs healing too, sometimes.

decline.text: Then I'll pray it knits on its own. Go in peace.

in_progress.text: The wound still aches, friend. That golden carrot?

ready.text: Ahh — the pain ebbs already. The light provides.

complete.text: Mended and grateful. Now I can get back to tending the rest. Bless you.
